case_number: 2024 INSC 212; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 270 OF 2019 AND CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 271 OF 2019

parties.respondent: The State Rep. By The Inspector Of Police

summary: Murder conviction under IPC s.302 and attempt to murder under s.307; ocular and medical evidence upheld; absence of respondent's name in FIR not exculpatory; private defence plea rejected; interested witness argument dismissed; delay in FIR registration not vitiated prosecution; High Court confirmation sustained; convictions and sentences upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; convictions under IPC s.302 and s.307 confirmed; sentences of life imprisonment and rigorous imprisonment upheld.
